# Every IMSI- or IMEI-shaped (15-16 digit) and E.164-shaped (+ and 10-15 digits)
# identifier that may appear in this repository.
#
# CI fails on any other one, because a 15-digit literal is most likely a real
# IMSI and a real IMSI is subscriber-identifying data.
#
# Rules for adding an entry:
#   * IMSIs use MCC 001 / MNC 01, the reserved test network.
#   * IMEIs come from documented example ranges and are not tied to a device.
#   * Add a comment saying which test or document uses the entry.
#
# Format: one identifier per line. Comments and blank lines are ignored.

# --- IMSIs, reserved test network (MCC 001, MNC 01) --------------------------
001010000000001
001010000000002
001010000000003

# --- Phone numbers (E.164) ---------------------------------------------------
# Use only these. +1 555 0100-0199 is reserved for fictional use in North America,
# so none of them can reach a real subscriber.
+15550100001
+15550100002
+15550100003
+15550100004
+15550100005
